Name: Talkohlooeys Style Professor Jasper Portrait (with Seasonal Outfit)
Author: Xezcente
TagLine: An HD portrait for Lemurkat's Professor Jasper Thomas NPC mod. Inspired by the style of Talkohlooeys.
Description:
## Description
Being a fan of Talkohlooeys Portraits and mods that add NPCs to the world, I wanted HD portraits for characters to match Talkohlooeys' style. I figured I'll try my hand at creating portraits for one of Lemurkat's wonderful NPC mod, Professor Jasper Thomas. I tried my best to capture the style of the original. It's my first time doing art and I hope it doesn't look too out of place with the rest of the characters.

## Requirements
**Content Patcher** by Pathoschild
**HD Portraits** by swyrl
**Professor Jasper Thomas** by Lemurkat

## Optional
**Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp﻿** by Poltergeister﻿
NOTE: Enable "SeasonalOutfits" to "True" for the additional outfits to take effect.

## Credits
**Lemurkat** for her awesome NPC creation
**Talkohlooeys** for creating my favorite portraits and inspiring this mod
**1oxnes** for allowing me to use their art asset (i.e. Junimo art)
**Poltergeister**﻿ for allowing me to use their clothing design and adapt it to this mod
**AirynS**, **Stephamoeba** and **OrangePieUwU** for their art, all of whom I took references and inspiration whenever I'm "stuck"
